crm_notes:
Account background: Elmwood Nova Systems builds a mid-market CX platform used by retail + finserv customers. They currently route NLU/chat + semantic search through another LLM API provider (OpenAI). Evaluating Redwood to solve rising token costs and gain better deployment/residency options.

Sales/eng summary (pitch progression):
- 2026-01: inbound interest after blog post on cost/perf; trial created.
- 2026-02: AE demo (Aisha) - showed hosted API quickstart, streaming, function-calls parity. Customer asked about model compatibility w/ existing prompt templates.
- 2026-02-14: technical POC kickoff (SE Luis running). Goal: parity for 4 canonical prompts (support triage, summary, rerank, embedding generation).
- 2026-03: POC mid-check: two prompts showing output drift vs prod vendor (temperature + tokenization differences). Eng asked for compat-layer suggestions and quantization impact.
- 2026-03-08: supplied POC results doc + token-cost comparison (drive link). Pricing discussion started for Dedicated reserved pool.

Quotes / call paraphrases:
- "We need answers on prompt parity and nondeterministic regressions before we can swap producers." — Head of ML (S. Patel)
- "Latency target is hard SLO for chat; 95p < 150ms in-region or we can't move certain customers." — Product lead

Observed risks: prompt outputs differ subtly for edge cases (legalese, redaction). Token accounting differences cause slight cost delta in long-context flows. Migration path must include: compat-layer shim, unified prompt templates, rerun regressions against saved eval set, shipping logging hooks for audits.

Operational asks: SSO/SAML setup, SOC2 attestation copy, option for US-only residency, KMS integration for key wrapping. Finance prefers a 12-month reserved commit (discount target ~30%).

Short, choppy next actions (internal language):
- SE to propose compat approach (shim + tokenizer mapping) by 2026-03-12.
- Pricing: draft committed TCO for 12mo Dedicated by 2026-03-15.
- Legal to review DPA/residency addendum (doc sent 2026-03-01).
